(async () => { const seen = []; let layerSeen = false; const observer = new MutationObserver(() => { if (document.querySelector('[data-dsh-chat-background-rotate-layer]')) layerSeen = true; }); observer.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true }); const start = Date.now(); while (Date.now() - start < 7000) { const name = localStorage.getItem('dsh-chat-background:selection'); if (seen.at(-1) !== name) seen.push(name); if (document.querySelector('[data-dsh-chat-background-rotate-layer]')) layerSeen = true; await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 45)); } observer.disconnect(); window.__rotationLog = { seen, layerSeen, image: document.documentElement.style.getPropertyValue('--dsh-chat-background-image') }; return JSON.stringify(window.__rotationLog); })()
